PMP.Anomaly.PsychicRitualDef_LegionChall.label: legion challenge: Warhound
PMP.Anomaly.PsychicRitualDef_LegionChall.description:
Perform the ritual to summon a Romulus legion warhound, a fast-closing melee mech capable of vaulting over cliffs. Prove your strength to earn its allegiance.
The ritual will consist of 1 round.
PMP.Anomaly.PsychicRitualDef_LegionChall.outcomeDescription: Prove your strength to earn the allegiance of a Romulus legion warhound. The ritual will consist of 1 round.

PMP.Anomaly.PsychicRitualDef_LegionChall.label: legion challenge: Legion guard
PMP.Anomaly.PsychicRitualDef_LegionChall.description:
Perform the ritual to summon a Romulus legion guard, a heavy mech armed with a massive shield and spear-gun, capable of withstanding astonishing punishment. Prove your strength to earn its allegiance.
The ritual will consist of 2 rounds.
PMP.Anomaly.PsychicRitualDef_LegionChall.outcomeDescription: Prove your strength to earn the allegiance of a Romulus legion guard. The ritual will consist of 2 rounds.

PMP.Anomaly.PsychicRitualDef_LegionChall.label: legion challenge: Legion chosen
PMP.Anomaly.PsychicRitualDef_LegionChall.description:
Perform the ritual to summon a Romulus legion chosen, an ultraheavy mech combining heavy protection with astonishing agility, capable of tearing apart formidable enemies. Prove your strength to earn its allegiance.
The ritual will consist of 3 rounds.
PMP.Anomaly.PsychicRitualDef_LegionChall.outcomeDescription: Prove your strength to earn the allegiance of a Romulus legion chosen. The ritual will consist of 3 rounds.
